_comment: wordPattern makes `#frames` and `@address` one word each, not a sigil beside a word. Completion replaces the word under the cursor, so without this, accepting `#frames` half-way through `#fra` would leave `##frames`; double-click selection and word-wise motion follow the same rule.
_autoCloseBefore: Autoclose a quote or bracket only before whitespace or a closing bracket — typing `"` in front of an identifier is nearly always a wrap, not a new string. The default set has no backtick reason to differ.
_onEnterRules: Continue a /* */ block on Enter, and close it when the cursor sits between the delimiters — the same behaviour C-family languages have, which this grammar's comments are.
